RoundPeg represents a round peg with a radius value and exposes its radius through an accessor. It provides default and radius-based construction and serves as the adaptee or target-side collaborator in an Adapter pattern context, supporting integration with incompatible shapes.

Test is a public entry-point class that contains a single main method for launching the application. Its responsibility is limited to startup execution, with no specific collaborators identified in the available analysis. No explicit design-pattern role was captured for this class.

SquarePegAdapter extends RoundPeg and adapts a SquarePeg collaborator to the round-peg interface by overriding getRadius(). It stores the wrapped SquarePeg instance and serves as an adapter-pattern participant, bridging incompatible shapes through inheritance and delegation.

SquarePeg represents a square-shaped peg with a stored width and accessors for width and computed square value. It collaborates with adapter-related code as part of an Adapter pattern structure, serving as the adaptee or domain-specific component that other classes can wrap or translate.
